data.name: Shropshire Council
data.description: Shropshire Council is the unitary local authority for Shropshire in England. As part of its climate strategy, it is building a council-owned biochar plant in Ludlow that is expected to deliver about 10,000 tonnes of physical carbon removal over its medium-term financial plan. CDR is a small side activity for a local government whose main job is public services.
